lastProgram.source:
repos = github.search_repositories(query="agent framework", limit=30)
details = map(repos, github.get_repository(full_name=_.full_name))
det = compute(details, ratio="forks/stars")
high = select(det, "ratio > 0.15")
low = select(det, "ratio <= 0.15")
highs = map(high, github.get_contributor_stats(full_name=_.full_name))
lows = map(low, github.list_commits(full_name=_.full_name))
merged = join(det, highs, key="full_name")
return merged
